# LandLens
> Pan-India cadastral land records platform. Click any plot to see ownership, area, type, and history. Unifies records from 28+ state portals.

## Core concepts
- **Parcel** — a land plot with a polygon, area, classification, and ownership records.
- **Khasra** — traditional state-level plot number.
- **ULPIN** — 14-digit national unique ID (Bhu-Aadhaar), being rolled out across India.
- **Boundary source tiers** — every polygon carries provenance: govt_bhunaksha (Tier 1, authoritative) → fmb_reconstructed → ai_with_constraints → osm → ai_only (Tier 5, needs verification).

## Machine-readable endpoints
- /api/openapi.json — full OpenAPI 3.1 spec (auto-generated from Zod schemas)
- /api/health — liveness + dependency health
- /api/parcels/{id} — single parcel (Sprint 3)
- /api/parcels/at?lat=X&lng=Y — point-in-polygon lookup (Sprint 3)
- /api/parcels/nearby?lat=X&lng=Y&radius_m=500 — radius search, geography-based (Sprint 3)
- /api/search?q=text&type=state|district|village|khasra|owner&state=LGD — unified search across boundaries, parcels, owners. Fuzzy (pg_trgm), multilingual (name_en/name_hi/name_local). Each result has `bbox` (boundaries) or `centroid` (parcels) for flyTo, plus an `ancestors` chain. (Sprint 4)

## Conventions
- All responses are JSON with an envelope `{ data, meta }` on success and `{ error: { code, message, suggested_action, docs_url } }` on failure.
- Mutations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (UUID v4 recommended). Retries with the same key within 24h replay the stored response.
- Locale-prefixed URLs: /en/..., /hi/..., /ur/... — Urdu renders RTL.

## For AI agents
- MCP server: mcp.land.trenlens.com (Sprint 12 — not yet live)
- In-app BYOK admin assistant: /admin/assistant (Sprint 13 — not yet live)
- Rate limit: 60 req/min/IP for public; 600 req/min/user for authenticated.

## Documentation
- Human: /docs
- Machine: /api/openapi.json
- Source: https://github.com/Black-Lights/landlens
